title: Go where death loses its swagger
summary: Meeting the humble lowers death's threat because mercy begins to dwell in the mind.
takeaway: Move toward the humble before fear chooses your posture.
lifeApplication: Before the next reply, raised voice, or hard stare, leave the doorway and sit near the quieter person in the room. Let humble company lower the body before anger calls itself courage.

source.shortMeaning: Humble company conquers death's messenger as the merciful Lord comes to dwell within the mind.
source.lifeApplication: When the body prepares to fight, move toward the humble before fear hardens into performance.

evidence.coreClaim: Humble company conquers death's messenger as the merciful Lord comes to dwell within the mind.
evidence.turn: Stand near humility until fear loses the authority to shape your next move.
